title: Fix 19 AdminTokensControllerTest failures on main since 2026-10-13
result: `AdminTokensController` read `posix_geteuid()` directly, so tests passed only as root. The root check is now an injectable closure (default unchanged); tests inject it and a non-root test was added.
evidence: `composer run test` as uid 501 passes (695 tests), lint:php, analyse, prettier and shellcheck clean locally.
